name: bare-stow
description: Module bundling and harness generation for Bare

extraSections.heading: Protocol
extraSections.body:
The harness multiplexes a control channel and a user data channel over the underlying binary duplex stream. The `ipc` returned from `start()` is itself a duplex stream carrying the user data; control frames ride alongside it on the same handle. RPC libraries (such as `bare-rpc`) bind to `ipc` just like a raw stream.

Control frames signal lifecycle events:

| Direction      | Type        | Payload              |
| :------------- | :---------- | :------------------- |
| Worker -> Host | `ready`     | -                    |
| Worker -> Host | `exit`      | `{ code }`           |
| Worker -> Host | `error`     | `{ message, stack }` |
| Host -> Worker | `terminate` | -                    |

An incoming `error` frame destroys the local `ipc` with the carried error, surfacing it as a normal stream `error` event. Other control frames emit a regular event named after the type.

The `ipc` handle exposes the lifecycle as events and methods on the same duplex:

- `ipc.ready`: A promise that resolves once the worker has signaled ready. Rejects if the worker errors before ready.
- `ipc.on('exit', code)`: Emitted when the worker signals exit. `code` carries the exit code.
- `ipc.on('error', err)`: Emitted when the worker reports a fault, or when the underlying transport errors. Either way the `ipc` is destroyed.
- `ipc.on('close')`: Emitted when the underlying transport closes.
- `ipc.destroy()`: Standard stream destroy. Sends a `terminate` control frame to the worker and waits for the underlying transport to close.
- `ipc.terminate()`: Like `destroy()` but resolves with the worker's exit code.

The framing layer is also exported directly for embedders that bring their own transport:

```js
const protocol = require('bare-stow/protocol')

const ipc = protocol.attach(stream) // Any duplex byte stream
ipc.write(Buffer.from('payload')) // User data
ipc.send('ready') // Control frame
ipc.on('exit', () => {
  /* ... */
})
```

The host helper layers the lifecycle promise and `terminate` method on top of the protocol:

```js
const { wrap } = require('bare-stow/host')

const ipc = wrap(stream) // Any duplex byte stream
await ipc.ready
```

extraSections.heading: CLI
extraSections.body:
#### `bare-stow [flags] <entry>`

Stow the module graph rooted at `<entry>`, writing the harness and bundle to the path given by `--out`.

```console
--version|-v
--target <name>
--client <name>
--server <name>
--base <path>
--out|-o <path>
--builtins <path>
--imports <path>
--defer <specifier>
--host <name>
--help|-h
```

##### `--target <name>`

The target runtime. Required. The built-in `bare-sidecar` and `bare-worker` are resolved directly; any other `<name>` is loaded from its `bare-stow-target-<name>` package, or from `<name>` itself as a full module specifier, resolved from the working directory.

##### `--client <name>` and `--server <name>`

The RPC library to wire into the harness (`--client`) or the bundle entry shim (`--server`). The built-in `bare-rpc` is resolved directly; any other `<name>` is loaded from its `bare-stow-rpc-<name>` package, or from `<name>` itself as a full module specifier, resolved from the working directory.

##### `--builtins <path>` and `--imports <path>`

Paths to JavaScript or JSON files exporting a list of builtin module names and a map of global import overrides respectively. Forwarded to `bare-pack`.

##### `--defer <specifier>`

A module specifier whose resolution should be deferred. May be passed multiple times.

##### `--host <name>`

A host triple to build for. Must be a subset of the host triples supported by the target. May be passed multiple times. Defaults to all host triples supported by the target.

exports.name: stow
signatures: stow(entry: URL | string, target: Target | TargetName, out: URL | string, opts?: StowOptions): AsyncGenerator<StowArtifact>
exports.description: Bundle the module graph rooted at `entry` for `target`, writing a harness plus bundle to `out`.

params.name: entry
params.description: The entry module to bundle, as a `file:` URL or path string.

params.name: target
params.description:
The bundling target: a `Target` object, or a target name resolved to one (the
built-in `bare-sidecar` and `bare-worker`, or a `bare-stow-target-<name>` package).

params.name: out
params.description:
The path to write the harness to, as a `file:` URL or path string; the bundle is
written alongside it.

returns.description:
An async generator that yields each written artifact's `url` as it is produced — the
harness first, then the bundle, then any offloaded addon or asset files.

throws.condition: A host in `opts.hosts` is not supported by the resolved target.

exports.name: Target
signatures:
interface Target {
  name: string
  linked: boolean
  offload: boolean | { addons?: boolean; assets?: boolean }
  format: 'bundle' | 'bundle.cjs' | 'bundle.mjs' | 'bundle.json'
  encoding: string | null
  extension: string
  module?: 'esm' | 'cjs'
  hosts: string[]
  generate(context: TargetContext): Artifact[]
}
exports.description:
A bundling target, such as `bare-sidecar` or `bare-worker`, describing how to package and boot a
bundle on a given host runtime.

members.name: encoding
members.description:
The text encoding used when the bundle format wraps the bundle as a string, or `null` when the
bundle is written as raw bytes.

members.name: extension
members.description: The file extension used for the target's harness artifact.

members.name: format
members.description: The encoding format of the written bundle artifact.

members.name: generate
members.description: Generate the harness artifacts for `context`.

params.name: context
params.description:
The target context describing the bundle to embed and the RPC wiring to splice
in.

members.name: hosts
members.description: The host triples the target supports.

members.name: linked
members.description: Whether the bundle links against its dependencies rather than inlining them.

members.name: module
members.description:
The module system the harness is generated in, `'esm'` or `'cjs'`. When unset, it follows the
output path's extension or nearest `package.json` `type`.

members.name: name
members.description: The target's name.

members.name: offload
signatures: offload: boolean | { addons?: boolean; assets?: boolean }
members.description:
Whether native addons and/or assets are written out as sibling files instead of being inlined
into the bundle.

exports.name: TargetContext
signatures:
interface TargetContext {
  bundleSpecifier: string
  ipc: string
  rpc: string
  module: 'esm' | 'cjs'
  client: RPCClient | null
}
exports.description:
The context passed to a target's `generate()`, describing the bundle to embed and the RPC wiring
to splice in.

members.name: bundleSpecifier
members.description: The module specifier the harness uses to load the bundle, relative to the harness itself.

members.name: client
members.description:
The resolved client RPC wiring to splice into the harness, or `null` when no client RPC was
requested.

members.name: ipc
members.description: The identifier bound to the IPC stream in generated harness code.

members.name: module
members.description: The module system the harness is generated in, `'esm'` or `'cjs'`.

members.name: rpc
members.description: The identifier bound to the RPC client/server in generated harness code.

exports.name: RPC
exports.description:
An RPC library adapter that generates the wiring code spliced into a stowed bundle's harness or
entry shim.

members.name: generate
members.description: Generate the RPC wiring artifacts for `context`.

params.name: context
params.description:
The RPC context describing the identifiers, module system, and role to
generate wiring for.

members.name: name
members.description: The RPC adapter's name.

exports.name: RPCContext
exports.description: The context passed to an RPC adapter's `generate()`.

members.name: ipc
members.description: The identifier bound to the IPC stream in generated code.

members.name: module
members.description: The module system the generated code targets, `'esm'` or `'cjs'`.

members.name: role
members.description:
Whether the generated wiring is for the `'client'` (harness side) or `'server'` (bundle entry
shim side).

members.name: rpc
members.description: The identifier bound to the RPC client/server in generated code.

exports.name: RPCClient
exports.description:
The resolved client RPC wiring, carrying both the runtime source to splice into the harness and
the type declaration to splice into the harness's `.d.ts`.

members.name: source
members.description: The generated runtime source for the client RPC wiring.

members.name: type
members.description: The generated type declaration for the client RPC wiring.

exports.name: Artifact
exports.description: A single generated source artifact, such as a harness or a type declaration.

members.name: extension
members.description:
The file extension the artifact should be written with alongside the primary output, or unset
to write it to the primary output path itself.

members.name: source
members.description: The artifact's source text.

exports.name: StowOptions
signatures:
interface StowOptions {
  client?: RPC | RPCName
  server?: RPC | RPCName
  resolveTarget?(name: string): Target
  resolveRPC?(name: string): RPC
  concurrency?: number
  base?: URL | string
  defaultType?: number
  importType?: number
  artifacts?: boolean
  deferUnresolved?: boolean
  mount?: URL | string
  builtinProtocol?: string
  builtins?: Builtins
  conditions?: Conditions
  defer?: string[]
  deferredProtocol?: string
  directories?: boolean
  engines?: Engines
  extensions?: string[]
  imports?: ImportsMap
  matchedConditions?: string[]
  resolutions?: ResolutionsMap
  host?: string
  hosts?: string[]
  linkedProtocol?: string
}

members.name: client
members.description: The RPC library (or its name) to wire into the harness.

members.name: defaultType
members.description:
The type to assume for a module that has no type of its own, such as one
with an ambiguous extension or a `data:` URL that no import reaches. See
`constants` for possible values.

members.name: deferUnresolved
members.description:
Record a specifier that resolves nowhere under `deferredProtocol` rather
than throwing, leaving it for whoever names it to resolve when they get
there. Only for callers that reach a resolver again, such as a module
system; a tool that only links wants the error.

An addon resolved for several `hosts` must resolve for each of the native
ones, as WebAssembly hosts are only a fallback. A host that it resolves
nothing for is unresolved, and is deferred under its own conditions or
else fails with `ADDON_NOT_FOUND`.

members.name: importType
members.description:
The type of the import that led to the entry. A JavaScript `data:` URL
takes its type from this: `REQUIRE` means a script and `IMPORT` a module,
while `IMPORT | DYNAMIC` could mean either and so needs a `type`
attribute.

members.name: mount
members.description:
The URL the entry is mounted at when it is a bundle, for consumers that
load it with an explicit mount. The addons and assets it declares resolve
relative to this. Defaults to the URL of the entry itself.

members.name: resolveRPC
members.description: Resolve an RPC name to an `RPC`, overriding the default RPC resolution.

params.name: name
params.description: The RPC name to resolve to an `RPC`.

members.name: resolveTarget
members.description: Resolve a target name to a `Target`, overriding the default target resolution.

params.name: name
params.description: The target name to resolve to a `Target`.

members.name: server
members.description: The RPC library (or its name) to wire into the bundle's entry shim.

exports.name: StowArtifact
exports.description: An artifact written by `stow()`, yielded once its file has been written.

members.name: url
members.description: The file URL the artifact was written to.

exports.name: Protocol

members.name: Protocol
members.description: Attach a `Protocol` to the given underlying duplex byte `stream`.

params.name: stream
params.description:
The underlying duplex byte stream to multiplex the control and user-data
channels over.

members.name: send
members.description: Send a control frame of `type` with an optional JSON-serializable `payload`.

params.name: type
params.description:
The control frame type, for example `'ready'`, `'exit'`, `'error'`, or
`'terminate'`.

params.name: payload
params.description: An optional JSON-serializable payload carried with the frame.

exports.name: ProtocolEvents
signatures:
interface ProtocolEvents {
  ready: []
  terminate: []
  exit: [code: number]
  data: [data: unknown]
  end: []
  readable: []
  piping: [dest: Writable]
  close: []
  error: [err: Error]
  drain: []
  finish: []
  pipe: [src: Readable]
}
exports.description: The events emitted by a `Protocol`, in addition to the standard duplex stream events.

members.name: exit
members.description: Emitted when the worker signals exit, carrying its exit `code`.

members.name: ready
members.description: Emitted when the worker signals it is ready.

members.name: terminate
members.description: Emitted when a `terminate` control frame is received.

exports.name: attach
exports.description: Attach a `Protocol` to `stream`, an underlying duplex byte stream.

params.name: stream
params.description: Any duplex byte stream to attach the protocol to.

returns.description: A `Protocol` multiplexing control and user-data frames over `stream`.

exports.name: CONTROL
exports.description: The frame type marker identifying a control-channel frame.

exports.name: USER
exports.description: The frame type marker identifying a user-data-channel frame.

exports.name: wrap
exports.description:
Wrap the host side of a stowed bundle's transport `stream`, returning an `IPC` handle with
lifecycle helpers layered on top of the `Protocol`.

params.name: stream
params.description: The host side of a stowed bundle's transport (any duplex byte stream).

returns.description:
An `IPC` handle wrapping `stream`, with the `ready` promise and `terminate()` layered on
top of `Protocol`.

exports.name: IPC

members.name: IPC
members.description: Wrap the host side of a stowed bundle's transport `stream`.

params.name: stream
params.description: The host side of a stowed bundle's transport (any duplex byte stream).

members.name: ready
members.description:
A promise that resolves once the worker has signaled ready, and rejects if the worker errors
before then.

members.name: send
members.description: Send a control frame of `type` with an optional JSON-serializable `payload`.

params.name: type
params.description:
The control frame type, for example `'ready'`, `'exit'`, `'error'`, or
`'terminate'`.

params.name: payload
params.description: An optional JSON-serializable payload carried with the frame.

members.name: terminate
members.description: Send a `terminate` control frame to the worker and resolve with its exit code once it exits.

returns.description: The worker's exit `code` once it exits.
